response.evidence: Most White male applicants in the file have 'Loan originated' outcomes. Denials for White male applicants form a small minority of their records, and that share appears no higher than the overall denial rate. Denied White male records typically show high debt-to-income ratios (50% or more) or near-zero income, the same risk factors seen in denials across other groups. The data lacks complete underwriting variables (such as credit score and stated denial reasons) and includes no formal statistical test, so it cannot rule out bias in any individual case. It does not show a pattern of disproportionate denial against White males.
